description.en: The read-only fields of one record, read through a grid data source for the id of the request (params.id).
description.fa: فیلدهای فقط‌خواندنی یک رکورد از منبع داده جدولی برای شناسه درخواست (params.id).

id.description: The id of the record view

url.description: The url of the grid data source that holds the record: /d/{key}

idField.description: The row property that holds the record id

fields.description: The fields shown (key, label, type, wide, mono)

backUrl.description: Where the back button goes; none without it

backLabel.description: The label of the back button

editUrl.description: Where the edit button goes (the id is added as /{id}); none without it

editLabel.description: The label of the edit button

related.description: Child tables under the record (id, title, url, idField, columns); the url filters a grid data source by the record id, for example /d/children?f.parentId={{params.id|url}}
